# Friends reference

The friends component, the stored friend data, the persistence and platform seams, the server-side friends service and the player directory that finds offline players. For how to use it, see [Friends](../modules/friends.md).

## VtUnitFriends

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Friends → VtUnitFriends**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

A player's friends list: in-game friends and requests from the server, plus platform friends such as Steam from the local client, merged by `GetView`. Opt in through `VtUnitDefinition.useFriends`; needs a `VtPlayerIdentity` on the same object.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `string PlayerId { get; }` | The player id friendships are keyed on, or empty without an identity. |
| `VtFriendRecord Record { get; }` | This player's record: the server's on the authority, the replicated one on a client. Null without an id. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtFriendLink> Friends { get; }` | In-game friends. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtFriendRequest> Incoming { get; }` | Requests waiting for this player's answer. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtFriendRequest> Outgoing { get; }` | Requests this player sent that are still open. |
| `event Action<VtFriendRecord> OnFriendsChanged` | Fires when friends or requests changed. The argument is the new record, or null. |
| `event Action<string, bool> OnFriendPresenceChanged` | Fires when an in-game friend came online or went offline: (friend id, online). |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache the identity and listen to the friends service. Idempotent; call again after adding an identity late. |
| `bool IsOnline(string friendId)` | True when the in-game friend `friendId` is online. |
| `void GetView(List<VtFriendView> results)` | Fill `results` with in-game and platform friends merged into one list. |
| `bool SendRequest(string playerNameOrId, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Send a friend request to a player by name or id, online or offline. |
| `bool Accept(string fromPlayerId, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Accept the request from `fromPlayerId`. |
| `bool Decline(string fromPlayerId, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Decline the request from `fromPlayerId`. |
| `bool Cancel(string toPlayerId, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Withdraw the request sent to `toPlayerId`. |
| `bool Remove(string friendPlayerId, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | End the friendship with `friendPlayerId`. |
| `void ApplyFriendsFromNet(VtFriendRecord record, IEnumerable<string> onlineFriendIds)` | Replace this player's view of its friends and which of them are online. Used by replication; not authority-gated. |
| `void ApplyPresenceFromNet(string friendId, bool online)` | Update one friend's presence on a client. Used by replication; not authority-gated. |

## VtFriendRecord

Serializable class.

One player's friends and pending requests. Plain data that serializes with `JsonUtility`; change it only through `VtFriends`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player Id (`playerId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id this record belongs to. |
| Friends (`friends`) | List of [VtFriendLink](#vtfriendlink) | Empty | Accepted friends. |
| Incoming (`incoming`) | List of [VtFriendRequest](#vtfriendrequest) | Empty | Requests other players sent to this player, waiting for an answer. |
| Outgoing (`outgoing`) | List of [VtFriendRequest](#vtfriendrequest) | Empty | Requests this player sent, waiting for an answer. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtFriendLink FindFriend(string otherId)` | The friendship with `otherId`, or null. |
| `bool IsFriend(string otherId)` | True when `otherId` is a friend. |
| `VtFriendRequest FindIncoming(string otherId)` | The request received from `otherId`, or null. |
| `VtFriendRequest FindOutgoing(string otherId)` | The request sent to `otherId`, or null. |

## VtFriendLink

Serializable class.

An accepted friendship, as seen from one side.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player Id (`playerId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id of the friend. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty | The friend's name when last seen. Updated when the friend renames. |
| Since (`since`) | `double` | 0 | When the friendship began, in UTC seconds since 1970. |

## VtFriendRequest

Serializable class.

A pending friend request, as seen from one side.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player Id (`playerId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id of the other side: the requester on an incoming request, the recipient on an outgoing one. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty | The other side's name when last seen. |
| Sent At (`sentAt`) | `double` | 0 | When the request was sent, in UTC seconds since 1970. It drops after Friend Request Expiry Days. |

## VtFriendView

Serializable struct.

One row of a merged friends window: in-game friends and platform friends combined.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player Id (`playerId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id of the friend. For a platform-only friend, its platform id mapped through VtFriends.PlatformIdToPlayerId. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty | Name to show. |
| In Game Friend (`inGameFriend`) | `bool` | Off | On when the player is an in-game friend. |
| Platform Friend (`platformFriend`) | `bool` | Off | On when the player is a friend on the platform, such as Steam. |
| Online (`online`) | `bool` | Off | On while the friend is online, in game or on the platform. |
| Playing This Game (`playingThisGame`) | `bool` | Off | On while the friend is running this game. |

## VtPlatformFriend

Serializable struct.

A friend on an external platform such as Steam, as reported on the local client.

### Inspector fields

## VtPlayerRecord

Serializable class.

## IVtFriendsStore

Interface. Implemented by [VtJsonFriendsStore](#vtjsonfriendsstore), `VtMemoryFriendsStore`.

Where friend records persist, one record per player. `VtFriends` loads a record the first time it is needed and saves after every change, so an implementation may write asynchronously. An online game implements this against its database.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtFriendRecord Load(string playerId)` | The stored record for `playerId`, or null when there is none. |
| `void Save(VtFriendRecord record)` | Persist `record`. |

## VtJsonFriendsStore

Class.

Stores each player's friend record as a JSON file in a folder.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtFriendRecord Load(string playerId)` | The record in the player's file, or null when the file does not exist. |
| `void Save(VtFriendRecord record)` | Write the record to the player's JSON file, creating the folder when needed. |

## IVtPlatformFriendsProvider

Interface.

Supplies the local user's friends from a platform such as Steam. Platform friends are known only on the user's own machine, so set a provider on the client through `VtFriends.PlatformProvider`; the server never uses it.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `string PlatformName { get; }` | Name shown next to platform friends, such as "Steam". |
| `event Action OnChanged` | Fires when the platform friends or their presence changed. |
| `void GetFriends(List<VtPlatformFriend> results)` | Fill `results` with the local user's platform friends. |

## IVtPlayerDirectoryStore

Interface. Implemented by [VtJsonPlayerDirectoryStore](#vtjsonplayerdirectorystore), `VtMemoryPlayerDirectoryStore`.

Where the player directory persists. The service writes after every change.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |

| `void Save(VtPlayerRecord record)` | Persist one player's record. |

Class.

Stores each player record as a JSON file in a folder.

### Scripting API

## VtFriends

Static class.

The friends service. Runs on the authority: friend requests to online or offline players, accepting, declining, cancelling and removing, with both sides kept in step and persisted through `Store`. Raises presence events when a friend comes online or goes offline. Players reach it through `VtUnitFriends`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static IVtFriendsStore Store { get; set; }` | Where records persist. Setting it clears the cache. |
| `static Func<double> Clock { get; set; }` | Wall-clock seconds for request times and expiry. Null restores UTC time. |
| `static event Action<VtFriendRecord> OnRecordChanged` | Fires after a player's record changed. |
| `static event Action<string, string, bool> OnFriendPresenceChanged` | Fires when a friend came online or went offline: (player whose friend it is, friend id, online). |
| `static IVtPlatformFriendsProvider PlatformProvider` | The local user's platform friends, such as Steam. Client-side only; null when none. |
| `static Func<string, string> PlatformIdToPlayerId` | Maps a platform id to a player id so a platform friend who plays the game merges with the in-game friendship. Default: the ids are the same, as when player ids are SteamIDs. |
| `static VtFriendRecord GetRecord(string playerId)` | The record for `playerId`, loaded or created, with expired requests dropped. |
| `static bool IsOnline(string playerId)` | True while `playerId` is online in this process. |
| `static bool SendRequest(string fromId, string targetIdOrName, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Send a friend request from `fromId` to a player by name or id, online or not. A request the other player already sent is accepted instead. |
| `static bool Accept(string playerId, string fromId, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Accept the request `playerId` received from `fromId`. |
| `static bool Decline(string playerId, string fromId, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Turn down the request `playerId` received from `fromId`. |
| `static bool Cancel(string playerId, string toId, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Withdraw the request `playerId` sent to `toId`. |
| `static bool Remove(string playerId, string friendId, out VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | End the friendship between the two players, on both sides. |
| `static void Rename(string playerId, string displayName)` | Update the name every friend and requester sees for `playerId`. |
| `static void BuildView(VtFriendRecord record, Func<string, bool> isOnline, List<VtFriendView> results)` | Merge in-game friends from `record` with the local platform friends into `results`. Rows for the same player combine; online is true when either side reports it. |
| `static void EnsureHooked()` | Start watching identities for presence and the directory. Idempotent; the friends component calls it. |
| `static void ResetState()` | Clear the cache, unhook, and return to an empty in-memory store. |

## VtPlayerDirectory

Static class.

Every player the server has seen, online or not, so friend requests and mail can find a player by name after they logged off. Filled automatically from `VtPlayerIdentity` once any social component initializes; persists through `Store`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static IVtPlayerDirectoryStore Store { get; set; }` | Where records persist. Setting it reloads from the new store. |
| `static Func<double> Clock { get; set; }` | Wall-clock seconds for last-seen times. Null restores UTC time. |
| `static IReadOnlyCollection<VtPlayerRecord> All { get; }` | Every known player. |
| `static event Action<VtPlayerRecord> OnRecordChanged` | Fires after a record was added or changed. |
| `static void EnsureHooked()` | Start recording players as they come online. Idempotent; social components call it. |
| `static VtPlayerRecord Record(string playerId, string displayName)` | Add or update a player and stamp the last-seen time. |
| `static VtPlayerRecord FindById(string playerId)` | The record for `playerId`, or null. |
| `static bool TryFind(string idOrName, out VtPlayerRecord record)` | Find a player by id, or by name ignoring case: online first, then most recently seen. |
| `static void ResetState()` | Forget memory, unhook, and return to an empty in-memory store. |

## Enums

### VtFriendsFailureReason

Why a friends call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The call succeeded. |
| `NoIdentity` | The player has no player identity. |
| `PlayerNotFound` | No known player by that name or id. |
| `CannotBefriendSelf` | A player cannot befriend itself. |
| `AlreadyFriends` | Already friends. |
| `RequestPending` | A request to that player is already waiting. |
| `FriendListFull` | The player has `VtTuning.friendsMaxCount` friends. |
| `TargetFull` | The other player's friend list or request inbox is full. |
| `NoRequest` | No such pending request. |
| `NotFriends` | The players are not friends. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |
